answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 168178 Country: India Title: Please tell me to get success in examination, which is not qualifying the exams? Question: Please tell me to get success in examination, which is not qualifying the exams? Answer ID: 168178 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 444/372/D=05/1440) Read يا أرحم الراحمين extensively. In-shaAllah, you shall succeed in your exam. Similarly, read the below dua extensively: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْماً رَبِّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
